_doc: Named configurations, 'method+name': environment overrides on top of the method's defaults, one configuration for every sequence. cov..dense: the first MOLA-LIO candidates (now part of the tuning grid); map*: the map-extent ablation.

cov._why: LiDAR increment weighted by its ICP covariance, so the IMU leads where the registration is degenerate

loose._why: looser fixed LiDAR increment sigmas: more IMU authority everywhere

imu._why: IMU noise model set to the sensor's datasheet values (noise density, bias random walk)

dense._why: twice the ICP point budget, finer ICP voxels

map1km._why: MOLA local map kept within 1 km instead of 100 m

map200m._why: FAST-LIO2 local map box of 200 m instead of 1 km

knnplane._why: MOLA's front end with Fast-LIO2's k-NN plane matching instead of GICP, everything else unchanged (adaptive threshold kept on)

novdf._why: front-end factor: local map view-direction filter off

iters64._why: front-end factor: four times the ICP iterations

pts20k._why: front-end factor: ICP point budget 20000 (almost no decimation)

kfmap._why: front-end factor: keyframe local map instead of the incremental point cloud

lam1e4._why: development: weaker in-plane term of the plane-to-plane cost

lam1e5._why: development: weaker in-plane term of the plane-to-plane cost

gate05._why: development: at least 0.5 m between local map updates

gate10._why: development: at least 1 m between local map updates

cov30._why: development: sample by coverage, every occupied 0.30 m voxel in both stages

cov30s2._why: development: sample by coverage, 0.30 m voxels, ICP stage one in two

cov20s2._why: development: sample by coverage, 0.20 m voxels, ICP stage one in two

idx05._why: development: local map index cells of 0.5 m (same result, CPU only)

idx025._why: development: local map index cells of 0.25 m (same result, CPU only)

gyro._why: development: gyroscope rotation prior inside the ICP, shipped sigmas (needs mola_lidar_odometry >= 577d3f2)

up._why: development (needs the dev overlay): gravity-aware side test on horizontal surfaces

gyroup._why: development (needs the dev overlay): gravity-aware side test on horizontal surfaces + gyro

gcov30up._why: development (needs the dev overlay): gravity-aware side test on horizontal surfaces + gcov30

gyroside._why: development: gyro + the gravity-aligned side test as a map option (mola_metric_maps with ViewDirectionFilter::SurfaceSideGravityAligned)

side._why: development: the gravity-aligned side test as a map option, alone (mola_metric_maps with ViewDirectionFilter::SurfaceSideGravityAligned)
